title: Q-GAP-chat-entry: Hand a task to the system from a team chat
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rnd --holds 'file:seed/worker/src/chat-intake.js'
**Prediction:** market_open_gaps <= 3 within 720 h
**Status:** closed

Gap in component `idea-intake`: Hand a task to the system from a team chat. Work enters through the front door, the repository form, the work API and the owner console; a team chat is not an entry point. Source: doctrine/market.json (MARKET-1). The proof is `file:seed/worker/src/chat-intake.js`, shipped with a test.

**Out of scope:** any other gap in the register, and a proof file with no behaviour and no test behind it.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rnd --holds 'file:seed/worker/src/chat-intake.js'

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:10:18Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.3 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
